recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Avoid duplicating the same guidance on http.html unless the work group explicitly wants additional cross-linking, because duplicate normative wording could drift.
issue_request: FHIR-36095 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution asking the specification to clarify whether POST-based search is allowed in batch/transaction Bundles or how it should be represented there.
initial_application: The accepted guidance was applied in source/search.html by commit b464a229a5f3fc4f8d1cde220ed7fbcbad74fc2c, which replaced a TODO referencing FHIR-36095 with text saying Bundle searches should be accepted via GET, POST-based searches have no standard Bundle representation, and GET-specific limitations should not be imposed.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes from 2022-02-28 match the Jira rationale: POST search parameters are hard to represent in a Bundle because Bundle entry bodies carry Resources. Related GET/POST search decisions refine general search transport rules but do not alter this Bundle-specific guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/search.html:636-653 already contains the rule requested by FHIR-36095, and source/documentation.html places Search under RESTful API (HTTP) documentation.

related_jiras.note: Clarified that servers supporting search SHALL support POST and SHOULD support GET generally; this explains the need for a Bundle-specific GET recommendation.
Defines additional normal POST-based search variants on search/http pages, but not POST-search encoding inside a Bundle.
Later decision declined to mandate both GET and POST globally and added a declaration mechanism, leaving FHIR-36095's Bundle-specific SHOULD guidance intact.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue asking to clarify POST-based search in batch or transaction Bundles.
evidence_items.learned: The final resolution requires GET search acceptance in Bundles, no standard POST-search Bundle encoding, and no GET-specific limitations there.

evidence_items.summary: The Batching Search Requests section already contains the accepted GET-in-Bundle guidance and POST-search non-standardization statement.
evidence_items.learned: The current source already conveys the FHIR-36095 rule to implementers.

evidence_items.summary: The documentation index lists Search under RESTful API (HTTP).
evidence_items.learned: The source page containing the rule is a current RESTful API documentation page rather than an out-of-scope artifact.
